new_candidates.body:
Hi,

I have been working on a micro-ROS integration for Connectivity Manager (Cortex-M4) of TI TMS320F2838x, on TMDSCNCD28388D board, with FreeRTOS, lwIP and UDP transport.

The project uses the standard micro_ros_setup static library workflow (`generate_lib` in `micro_ros_static_library_builder`), with a toolchain file for TI Arm Clang and TI's archiver to pack the library. It also comes with CCS examples, CI and a first release for Jazzy, tested on the board mentioned.

Repo: https://github.com/konstc/micro_ros_f2838x_cm

Would it be useful to add it to micro_ros_setup as a standalone component, and is this kind of contribution in scope?

Thanks!
new_candidates.title: Standalone component for TI F2838x Connectivity Manager
